# Staff Frontend Engineer, Design Systems — Orbitale (fictional)

Orbitale makes planning software for logistics companies. Remote within Germany, with a monthly team week in Munich.

## Requirements

- 8+ years of frontend engineering, including 3+ years at senior level.
- Led a design system used by several product teams.
- Expert in React, TypeScript and CSS.
- Experience with Storybook and visual regression testing.
- Mentoring other engineers.

## Preferred

- Contributions to open-source UI libraries.
- Experience with web components.

Relocation within Germany is supported.
